tests.name: qemu_shell_probe_assertions
tests.command: rm -f build/qemu-debug.log && timeout 20s qemu-system-i386 -kernel build/kernel.bin -display none -debugcon file:build/qemu-debug.log -global isa-debugcon.iobase=0xe9 -no-reboot -no-shutdown || true

tests.name: qemu_filesystem_multiwriter_assertions
tests.command: rm -f build/qemu-debug.log && timeout 20s qemu-system-i386 -kernel build/kernel.bin -display none -debugcon file:build/qemu-debug.log -global isa-debugcon.iobase=0xe9 -no-reboot -no-shutdown || true
fail_markers: fs multi verify ramfs a failed
fs multi verify ramfs b failed
fs multi verify tinyfs a failed
fs multi verify tinyfs b failed

tests.name: qemu_filesystem_mixed_assertions
tests.command: rm -f build/qemu-debug.log && timeout 20s qemu-system-i386 -kernel build/kernel.bin -display none -debugcon file:build/qemu-debug.log -global isa-debugcon.iobase=0xe9 -no-reboot -no-shutdown || true
fail_markers: ToyOS: fs mixed probe ramfs a fault
ToyOS: fs mixed probe tinyfs a fault
ToyOS: fs mixed probe ramfs b fault
ToyOS: fs mixed probe tinyfs b fault
